# Hermes Template

> Local-first, platform-agnostic Vue 3 + TypeScript application template
> shipping a **scaffold-only** shell: Zod-authored domain types, a typed API
> client surface and example service/store stubs, and five layout-only pages.
> **All code is documented** — every file ships a header + TSDoc on public
> symbols (see `AGENTS.md` §6).

## Project

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — global context boundary & rules (read first)
- [README.md](README.md) — human-oriented overview & quickstart
- [llms.txt](llms.txt) — this machine-readable index

## Recursive agent boundaries

Nearest `AGENTS.md` to the file you touch wins on conflict.

- [Source root](src/AGENTS.md)
- [Types](src/types/AGENTS.md) · [lib](src/lib/AGENTS.md) · [services](src/services/AGENTS.md) · [stores](src/stores/AGENTS.md) · [router](src/router/AGENTS.md) · [pages](src/pages/AGENTS.md)
- [Components](src/components/AGENTS.md) · [ui (immutable)](src/components/ui/AGENTS.md) · [generated](src/components/generated/AGENTS.md)
- [Docs](docs/AGENTS.md) · [Requirements](docs/requirements/AGENTS.md) · [Domain](docs/domain/AGENTS.md)
- [Mockups](mockups/AGENTS.md)
